description: Get GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification and safety data for one or more compounds by CID. Returns signal word, pictograms, hazard statements (H-codes), and precautionary statements (P-codes) per compound, merged across sources, plus each source's own classification — its signal word, pictograms, H-codes with ECHA notifier agreement percentages, and notification counts — since sources often disagree. Reports ECHA "Not Classified" verdicts as their own status.

cids.description: PubChem Compound IDs to fetch safety data for. The per-call cap is 25: the first 25 are looked up, and any past that (up to 1000 in all) are returned in unprocessed, in input order, and reported in cappedInputs. Resolve from names/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

name: pubchem_get_compound_safety

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

items.description: One input served at its per-call cap.

requested.description: Value requested: the page size, or the number of IDs in the batch.

unprocessed.description: ID batches only: IDs past the cap, listed in unprocessed in input order.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when one or more CIDs returned no hazard classification, listing the unrecognized CIDs to verify, the CIDs that exist but carry no deposited classification, and the CIDs whose only classifications are "Not Classified" verdicts, each separately.

requestedCount.description: CIDs requested, including any past the per-call cap left in unprocessed.

results.description: Safety results, one per CID looked up (input order preserved). CIDs past the per-call cap are in unprocessed instead.

classifications.description: Each source's classification in PubChem's order — EU harmonised, the ECHA C&L aggregate, single-company ECHA notifications, NITE-CMC revisions, and others. Sources can disagree; the top-level fields merge them.

items.description: One source's GHS classification, kept whole.

hazardCodes.description: Hazard codes this classification assigns. Empty for a "Not Classified" verdict.

items.description: Hazard code assigned by this classification.

agreement.description: Share of notifying companies that assigned this code, exactly as PubChem prints it (e.g. "37.7%", "> 99.9%"). Present only where PubChem prints one beside the code, which is ECHA C&L classifications; read it against "notifications" — a single-company notification reports 100%.

code.description: H-code (e.g. "H319"). Statement text is in the top-level hazardStatements.

notClassified.description: True when this classification is ECHA's "Not Classified" verdict: notifiers assessed the compound and found it meets no GHS hazard criteria. Omitted otherwise.

notifications.description: Notifier counts behind an ECHA classification: the first line of ECHA's C&L notifications summary (e.g. "Aggregated GHS information provided per 13886 reports by companies from 79 notifications…"), or for a "Not Classified" verdict the verdict line (e.g. "Reported as not meeting GHS hazard criteria by 188 of 203 companies…"). Omitted for sources that deposit no counts.

signalWord.description: This classification's signal word. Omitted when the source assigns none.

source.description: Depositing source (e.g. "European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)", "NITE-CMC"). Omitted when PubChem names no reference for the classification.

sourceRecord.description: The source's own record title (e.g. "Ethanol - FY2013 (Revised classification)", "Ethanol (EC: 200-578-6)"). Tells revisions of one source, and the ECHA C&L aggregate from single-company ECHA notifications, apart.

hazardStatements.description: GHS hazard statements, union across classifications. A code here may come from a single source — see classifications for which source assigned it and with what notifier agreement.

pictograms.description: GHS pictogram labels (e.g. "Flammable", "Acute Toxic"), union across classifications.

precautionaryStatements.description: GHS precautionary statements, union across classifications.

decoded.description: Whether "statement" carries the standard text. False for codes needing label-specific fill text the depositor must supply (disposal method, firefighting agent, first-aid reference) and for codes outside the decoder table; the code itself is still authoritative.

statement.description: Standard precautionary statement text for the code. Empty string when "decoded" is false — PubChem deposits P-codes without text, so a blank statement means the code was not decoded, never that the depositor supplied an empty statement.

signalWord.description: GHS signal word, "Danger" or "Warning": the most severe any classification assigns. Omitted when none assigns one.

hasData.description: Whether a GHS classification is on file for this compound (status "ok" or "not_classified"); "ghs" is present exactly when this is true.

source.description: Sources that deposited a GHS classification, in PubChem's order, joined with "; ".

status.description: Outcome for this CID. "ok": GHS hazard classification returned. "not_classified": every deposited classification is an ECHA "Not Classified" verdict — notifiers assessed the compound and found it meets no GHS hazard criteria; the verdicts and their notifier counts are in ghs.classifications. "no_ghs_data": the compound exists in PubChem but has no deposited GHS classification. "cid_not_found": PubChem has no record for this CID at all — the identifier is wrong, so verify it with pubchem_search_compounds rather than concluding the compound is unclassified.

unprocessed.description: CIDs past the per-call cap of 25, in input order, not looked up. Pass them in a follow-up call. Omitted when every CID was looked up.

withDataCount.description: CIDs with a GHS classification on file (status "ok" or "not_classified").

title: Get Compound Safety
